records.source: I'll trade useful stuff for your extra books.
records.translation: 我會用實用物品交換你多餘的書。
M・拉斯莫迪斯的私人家具收藏。

records.source: My ex-wife took all the furniture.^^Fortunately, I had the good sense to make ethereal copies of everything and transcribe them into this book. Enjoy.^^-M. Rasmodius
records.translation: 我的前妻帶走了所有家具。^^幸好我明智地為每件家具製作了靈體複本，並將其抄錄在這本書中。請享用。^^——M・拉斯莫迪斯
未使用任何 Joja 服務！

records.source: Well, well, well... Look who 'made it' to the summit.#$b#Thought you were really clever, didn't you?#$b#'How can I cheat the system for my own benefit?', you thought.#$b#Or, in layman's terms: 'Me me me me me me me me me me me me me me me me'.#$b#Despicable.
records.translation: 哎呀，哎呀……看看是誰「抵達」了山頂。#$b#你以為自己很聰明，對吧？#$b#你心想：「該怎麼欺騙系統，好讓自己獲利？」#$b#用白話來說就是：「我我我我我我我我我我我我我我我我」。#$b#卑鄙。

records.source: Items placed inside will lose their quality overnight.
records.translation: 放入的物品會在一夜之間失去品質。

records.source: A bag of beautiful dried flowers.
This will catch more than a regular crab pot.
records.translation: 能捕獲比普通蟹籠更多的東西。

records.source: Your new neighbors seem to be thriving!
records.translation: 你的新鄰居似乎過得有聲有色！

records.source: Turn the Golden Clock back on?
records.translation: 要重新啟動黃金時鐘嗎？

records.source: This can process 3 eggs at a time.
records.translation: 一次可以加工 3 顆蛋。

records.source: This can process 3 jugs of milk at a time.
records.translation: 一次可以加工 3 壺牛奶。

records.source: This can process 3 pieces of wool at a time.
records.translation: 一次可以加工 3 份羊毛。

records.source: You start with a Fish Smoker.
records.translation: 開局時擁有一台燻魚機。

records.source: You can dress it up however you like.
records.translation: 可以隨心所欲替它穿搭。

records.source: You can dress it up however you like. And pray that it doesn't come to life while you sleep...
records.translation: 可以隨心所欲替它穿搭。然後祈禱它不會在你熟睡時活過來……
隱藏 IP 與邀請碼

records.source: A delightful pasta with broccoli and sun-dried tomatoes.
records.translation: 搭配青花菜與日曬番茄的美味義大利麵。

records.source: It naturally bubbles from the power of the melon skin.
records.translation: 瓜皮的力量使它自然冒出氣泡。

records.source: Pasta in a cream sauce with fresh vegetables.
records.translation: 搭配新鮮蔬菜與奶油醬汁的義大利麵。
